about.title: About Us
about.desc: The Palestine Math Olympiad is a national initiative dedicated to discovering, training, and empowering talented students in mathematics. Through a series of competitive stages, engaging workshops, and collaborative partnerships, we aim to strengthen mathematical excellence and inspire the next generation of problem-solvers and innovators across Palestine.

winterCamp.aboutDescription:
The Winter Training Camp for the Palestinian Mathematics Olympiad kicks off on Saturday, January 10th, 2026, and will run for six days, graciously hosted by Al-Istiqlal University in Jericho.

A total of 53 students from 18 districts are participating in this camp, selected through a rigorous, multi-stage selection process. This process began at the school level with over 5,000 students, then 1,046 students advanced to the district level, followed by a pre-final stage with 140 students, culminating in the final stage with 53 students from 18 districts.

Additionally, the camp hosts international and local academics and supervisors specialized in global and Arab mathematics Olympiads, alongside local academics from several Palestinian universities, dedicating their time and expertise to elevate the scientific level of our students during this stage.

The training staff also includes supervisors from various directorates of the Palestinian Ministry of Education and Higher Education.

partner0.name: Mr. Maree Saws
partner0.description: Holds a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry and a Master's degree in Education from An-Najah National University. He worked as a science and chemistry teacher for ten years in the Ramallah and Tulkarm directorates, Head of the Training Department at the National Institute for Educational Training for ten years, Director of the Training Department at the General Administration of Supervision for four years, and Director General of the General Administration of Creativity and Excellence.

partner1.name: Dr. Ahmad Ammar
partner1.description: Dr. Ahmad Ammar is a professor of curricula and teaching methods, an advisor to the Global Campaign for Education, and an educational expert for several institutions. He held leadership positions in the Ministry of Education and served as the General Rapporteur of the Conference of Arab Ministers of Education (2021–2023). He has contributed to authoring training materials and providing training locally and internationally.

partner2.name: Ms. Shorouq Al-Khatib
partner2.description: Engineer Shorouq Al-Khatib is the STEM Programs Director at Taawon (Welfare Association). She has over eight years of experience in education and innovation in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. She holds a Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics Engineering from Birzeit University and a Master's degree in Business Administration from Anglia Ruskin University in the UK.

speaker0.subtitle: The Road to the International Mathematical Olympiad: From Passion to Competition
speaker0.description: University professor in the School of Operations Research and Information Engineering at Cornell University in New York, a member of the Center for Applied Mathematics, and an academic researcher at Amazon.

speaker1.name: Dr. Ahmad Al-Jundi
speaker1.subtitle: Mathematical Enjoyment: Between Competitions, Academic Study, and Practical Applications
speaker1.description: Professor of mathematics at Cairo University, holding a Master's and PhD in Number Theory, and actively involved in training and organizing mathematical Olympiads.

speaker2.name: Dr. Mohammad Khalil
speaker2.subtitle: Applying Mathematics to Solve Programming Problems
speaker2.description: Specialist in artificial intelligence and software development, and coach of the Palestinian Olympiad team in programming.

supervisor0.name: Dr. Rania Al-Wannan
supervisor0.subtitle: Academic Trainer
supervisor0.description: Associate Professor and Dean of the Faculty of Applied Sciences at Palestine Technical University – Kadoorie, with research interests in dynamical systems and numerical analysis.

supervisor1.name: Dr. Abdulrahim Mousa
supervisor1.subtitle: Academic Trainer
supervisor1.description: Assistant Professor of Applied Mathematics at Birzeit University.

supervisor2.name: Dr. Mohammad Al-Adam
supervisor2.subtitle: Academic Trainer
supervisor2.description: Associate Professor of Mathematics at Palestine Polytechnic University, specializing in linear algebra, matrix theory, and fractional derivatives. He graduated with distinction in both his bachelor’s and master’s degrees and earned his PhD from the University of Konstanz, Germany, in 2016 with excellent standing. He has published research and maintains international academic collaborations.

supervisor3.name: Dr. Mohammad Maraabeh
supervisor3.subtitle: Academic Trainer
supervisor3.description: Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Applied Mathematics at Palestine Technical University - Kadoorie. His expertise includes mathematical analysis, fuzzy systems, and fractional calculus. He has extensive experience in teaching and supervising graduate studies and has contributed to European FESTEM projects.

supervisor4.name: Ms. Reham Ahmad Masleh
supervisor4.subtitle: Educational Supervisor
supervisor4.description: Mathematics supervisor at the Jericho Directorate of Education since 2012. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics from Al-Quds University (2001) and a Master's degree in Teaching Mathematics from Al-Quds Bard College (2012).

supervisor5.name: Ms. Afaf Abdul-Afu Al-Zughair
supervisor5.subtitle: Educational Supervisor
supervisor5.description: Mathematics supervisor at the Hebron Directorate of Education since 2020. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics from Hebron University.

supervisor6.name: Ms. Nadin Adel Issa
supervisor6.subtitle: Educational Supervisor
supervisor6.description: Mathematics supervisor at the Bethlehem Directorate of Education. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics from Bethlehem University and a Master's degree in Methods of Teaching Mathematics from Al-Bard College / Abu Dis.

supervisor7.name: Mr. Salah Al-Din Khader
supervisor7.subtitle: Educational Supervisor
supervisor7.description: Mathematics supervisor in Deir Al-Ghusoun / Tulkarm. Completed graduate studies at Yarmouk University in 1994. Participated in the National Mathematics Olympiad in 2014, 2016, and 2018, and coached the Palestinian team for the Arab Championship of Mathematical and Logic Games in Tunisia 2024, achieving second place in the Arab ranking.

supervisor8.name: Ms. Raeda Husni Oweis
supervisor8.subtitle: Educational Supervisor
supervisor8.description: Holds a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics from the University of Jordan and a Master's degree in Applied Mathematics from the Arab American University. Co-author of the Tawjihi mathematics textbook (scientific and industrial streams). Mathematics supervisor in Jenin since 2006 and certified Olympiad trainer by ALECSO.

supervisor9.name: Ms. Lubna Abdul Qader Abu Basha
supervisor9.subtitle: Educational Supervisor
supervisor9.description: Mathematics supervisor at the Nablus Directorate of Education. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics from An-Najah National University. A Tawjihi science teacher for 20 years and a finalist in the Palestine Teacher Award 2016.

supervisor10.name: Mr. Kamal Al-Jamal
supervisor10.subtitle: Educational Supervisor
supervisor10.description: Mathematics supervisor at the Jerusalem Suburbs Directorate, working on improving mathematics teaching, supporting teachers, raising student achievement, and preparing students for participation in the Mathematics Olympiad through logical thinking and problem-solving training.
